title: Gitmap color record (one line of colors.ndjson)

id.description: Stable id: color_<slug(name)>_<order>. Symbols reference this, not a palette index.

order.description: Source palette index; disambiguator in the id.

rgb.description: Screen colour as an [r, g, b] integer triple (0..255), matching cmyk's array shape.

cmyk.description: Print/OCAD ink [c,m,y,k], each 0..1, snapped to OCAD's whole-percent (2 dp) grid.

renderOrder.description: Paint priority (higher = drawn on top). Distinct from `order` (palette index): the two diverge where a source's colour-list order differs from its draw order. Colours sort by this then id.
